release.content: pubrules 0.46.0 was released on 2026-11-19 from commit 146106f7e3f4fbba5a05bb63705d32fd1cda254b with these changes.

rows: pubrules's own suite is Given/When/Then on pubtest's steps: every scenario has its When, so the TEST-04 exception is gone, and the suite's copies of pubtest's file and output steps are dropped
Suites run on pubtest 0.2.2: a refusal's class and fields, empty quoted values, the asgi and URL adapters, and the other steps the fleet's move found missing

actions/apt-install installs apt packages (split on any whitespace) with their lists and .deb files kept in the Actions cache, keyed by runner image, architecture, package list and run and restored by the newest entry: a hit installs with --no-download and no apt-get update, a hit that will not install and a miss update and install through retry's loop and save this run's entry, and a refused cache service installs from the mirror
